-- ── Search: the era SettingsPanel search ── -- Tags are labels uppercased, matched by plain substring and scored by matched length. -- Results are the live rows, so writes work mid-search.
function BenillaOptionsSearch_Words(text) local up = string.upper(text) local words = { up } for w in string.gfind(up, "([^, ]+)") do table.insert(words, w) end return words end
-- The era's MatchesSearchTags score, with a plain find. function BenillaOptionsSearch_Score(tag, words) for _, w in ipairs(words) do local first, last = string.find(tag, w, 1, true) if first then return last - first end end return nil end
function BenillaOptionsSearch_FindMatches(text) local words = BenillaOptionsSearch_Words(text) local buckets, scores = {}, {} for _, key in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do if BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey) local s = BenillaOptionsSearch_Score(row.searchTag, words) if s then if not buckets[s] then buckets[s] = {} table.insert(scores, s) end table.insert(buckets[s], { key = key, rkey = rkey }) end end end end -- Keybinding matches join the buckets; their rkey is the binding index. for _, m in ipairs(BenillaKeyBindings_SearchMatches(words)) do if not buckets[m.score] then buckets[m.score] = {} table.insert(scores, m.score) end table.insert(buckets[m.score], { key = "Keybindings", rkey = m.index }) end table.sort(scores, function(a, b) return a > b end) local groups, order = {}, {} for _, s in ipairs(scores) do for _, m in ipairs(buckets[s]) do if not groups[m.key] then groups[m.key] = {} table.insert(order, m.key) end table.insert(groups[m.key], m.rkey) end end return order, groups end
-- ── The page scroll ── -- Only frames hung off the body's top are measured, so the size converges. function BenillaOptionsScroll_ContentBottom() local bottom = nil local function take(name) local f = getglobal(name) if f and f:IsVisible() then local b = f:GetBottom() if b and (not bottom or b < bottom) then bottom = b end end end for _, key in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_CATEGORY_KEYS) do if BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key] then take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. key) for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey) end end end take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings") for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do take("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i) end -- The AddOns page's dynamic rows: row 0 is the Load out of date AddOns row. for i = 0, table.getn(BenillaOptionsAddOns_Rows) do local row = BenillaOptionsAddOns_Rows[i] if row then take(row:GetName()) end end return bottom end
-- The scroll frame's size in its own units, from its edges: its anchors size it, and -- GetWidth answers such a frame's span before the window's scale divides it. local function BenillaOptionsScroll_Size(sf) local l, r, t, b = sf:GetLeft(), sf:GetRight(), sf:GetTop(), sf:GetBottom() if not l or not r or not t or not b then return nil end return r - l, t - b end
-- The page's range is the body's overhang, the content Fit measures: the engine's range -- also counts the Keybindings list's faux scroll child, which is sized to every row. function BenillaOptionsScroll_Range(sf) local _, fh = BenillaOptionsScroll_Size(sf) if not fh then return 0 end local range = BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody:GetHeight() - fh if range > 0 then return range end return 0 end
-- From OnUpdate, off the previous frame's rects; SetWidth and SetHeight invalidate layout. function BenillaOptionsScroll_Fit() local sf = BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll local body = BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody local fw, fh = BenillaOptionsScroll_Size(sf) if not fw or fw <= 0 or not fh or fh <= 0 then return end if math.abs(body:GetWidth() - fw) >= 0.5 then body:SetWidth(fw) end local h = fh local top, bottom = body:GetTop(), BenillaOptionsScroll_ContentBottom() if top and bottom then local content = (top - bottom) + BENILLA_SCROLL_PAD if content > h then h = content end end if math.abs(body:GetHeight() - h) >= 0.5 then body:SetHeight(h) sf:UpdateScrollChildRect() -- The bar follows the body, which the range notify misses when the engine's range, -- a whole-subtree union, does not move. BenillaScroll_SyncBar(sf) end end
-- The era SettingsList layout: the head at (10,-12), each next at (0,-9), as in the XML. function BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) local f = getglobal(name) f:ClearAllPoints() if prev then f:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", prev, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, -9) f:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", prev, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 0, -9) else f:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody", "TOPLEFT", 10, -12) f:SetPoint("TOPRIGHT", "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody", "TOPRIGHT", -20, -12) end end
-- Back on the XML chain after a search; a test holds the two equal. function BenillaOptionsPage_Layout(key) local prev = nil for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[key]) do local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) getglobal(name):Show() prev = name end end
-- The title and no-match strings are ours: the era's are not in its UI source. function BenillaOptionsSearch_Display(text) BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0) for k in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k):Show() for _, rkey in ipairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS[k]) do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. k .. rkey):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. k):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindings"):Hide() getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings"):Hide() for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i):Hide() end -- The AddOns page is not in BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS; hide it and its rows with it. BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyAddOns:Hide() BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = nil BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil) BenillaOptionsFrameContainerUnbind:Hide() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerTitle:SetText("Search Results") BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Hide()
local order, groups = BenillaOptionsSearch_FindMatches(text) if table.getn(order) == 0 then BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Show() return end BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Hide() local prev = nil for _, key in ipairs(order) do local head = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. key BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(head, prev) getglobal(head):Show() prev = head if key == "Keybindings" then BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = {} local shown = 0 for _, index in ipairs(groups[key]) do if shown < BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS then shown = shown + 1 local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. shown BenillaKeyBindings_PaintBindRow(name, index) BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) getglobal(name):Show() BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted[name] = index prev = name end end else local placed = {} for _, rkey in ipairs(groups[key]) do local row = getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey) if row.parentRow and not placed[row.parentRow] then placed[row.parentRow] = 1 local pname = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. row.parentRow BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(pname, prev) getglobal(pname):Show() prev = pname end if not placed[rkey] then placed[rkey] = 1 local name = "BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBody" .. key .. rkey BenillaOptionsSearch_Place(name, prev) row:Show() prev = name end end BenillaOptionsPage_Refresh(key) end end end
function BenillaOptionsSearch_Restore() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerScroll:SetVerticalScroll(0) for k in pairs(BENILLA_OPTIONS_PAGE_ROWS) do BenillaOptionsPage_Layout(k) getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHead" .. k):Hide() end for i = 1, BENILLA_KEYBINDINGS_SEARCH_ROWS do getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyKeybindSearch" .. i):Hide() end getglobal("BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodySearchHeadKeybindings"):Hide() BenillaKeyBindingsPage.searchPainted = nil BenillaOptionsFrameContainerBodyNoResults:Hide() BenillaOptionsFrameContainerDefaults:Show() BenillaOptionsFrame_SelectCategory(BenillaOptionsFrame.selectedCategory or "Controls") end
function BenillaOptionsSearch_OnTextChanged(text) if text == BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText then return end local had = BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText and BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText ~= "" BenillaOptionsFrame.searchText = text if text == "" then if had then BenillaOptionsSearch_Restore() end else BenillaOptionsSearch_Display(text) end end

function BenillaOptionsRow_FormatValue(row, value) if row.fmt == "raw" then return string.format("%d", math.floor(value + 0.5)) end -- fork: "hours": a signed offset, `+3 h`, `0 h`, `-5 h`. if row.fmt == "hours" then local h = math.floor(value + 0.5) if h > 0 then return string.format("+%d h", h) end return string.format("%d h", h) end -- The clamp guards a short stops table. if row.stops then local i = math.floor(value + 0.5) + 1 if i < 1 then i = 1 end if i > table.getn(row.stops) then i = table.getn(row.stops) end return row.stops[i] end -- "gamma": the display gamma the ramp gives, `1 / gamma`. -- Read at load, after the chain's OptionsFrame.xml and before any addon. BENILLA_TURTLE_OPTIONS = type(GameOptions) == "table" and 1 or nil
if ( BENILLA_TURTLE_OPTIONS ) then -- Row labels, read through `_G[row.name]`: our rows' own. BENILLA_WORLD_SHADOWS = "Real Character Shadows" BENILLA_HD_MODELS = "Use updated character models" BENILLA_REFORGED_MODELS = "Use reforged game models and textures" BENILLA_LIGHTING_MODEL = "Lighting"

BENILLA_AUTO_LOOT = "Auto Loot" BENILLA_BACKGROUND_SOUND = "Enable Sound in Background" BENILLA_DISABLE_SPAM_FILTER = "Disable Spam Filter" BENILLA_TOOLTIP_AUTO_LOOT = "Take everything from a corpse as its loot window " .. -- Turtle's getter/setter shape for the plate globals: a getter its checkbox can -- `tonumber`, a setter handed the number its click computes or the string Defaults -- and Cancel write back. function BenillaTurtle_GetEnemyPlates() return NAMEPLATES_ON and "1" or "0" end function BenillaTurtle_SetEnemyPlates(value) BenillaOptionsFrame_SetEnemyPlates(tostring(value)) end function BenillaTurtle_GetFriendlyPlates() return FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON and "1" or "0" end function BenillaTurtle_SetFriendlyPlates(value) BenillaOptionsFrame_SetFriendlyPlates(tostring(value)) end
-- A dropdown's `<identifier>Dropdown_Init`, in the shape of Turtle's own -- (Options\Functions.lua): each entry picks through OptionsFrameDropdown_OnValueChanged. local function dropdown(cvar, entries) return function() local menu = getglobal(UIDROPDOWNMENU_INIT_MENU) for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do local info = {} info.text = entry.text info.value = entry.value info.func = OptionsFrameDropdown_OnValueChanged UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedValue(menu, GetCVar(cvar)) end end -- The entries our own rows offer, in their order. BenillaLightingModelDropdown_Init = dropdown("lightingModel", { { text = "Classic", value = "0" }, { text = "Modern", value = "1" }, }) BenillaLightingQualityDropdown_Init = dropdown("lightingQuality", { { text = "Low", value = "0" }, { text = "Medium", value = "1" }, { text = "High", value = "2" }, { text = "Ultra", value = "3" }, { text = "Cinematic", value = "4" }, }) BenillaGraphicsPresetDropdown_Init = dropdown("graphicsQuality", { { text = "Classic", value = "Classic" }, { text = "Low", value = "Low" }, { text = "Medium", value = "Medium" }, { text = "High", value = "High" }, { text = "Ultra", value = "Ultra" }, { text = "Cinematic", value = "Cinematic" }, { text = "Custom", value = "Custom" }, }) BenillaFoliageWindDropdown_Init = dropdown("foliageWind", { { text = "Off", value = "0" }, { text = "Grass", value = "1" }, { text = "Grass + Trees", value = "2" }, }) BenillaWaterDetailDropdown_Init = dropdown("waterDetail", { { text = "Modern", value = "2" }, { text = "Modern (Experimental)", value = "3" }, { text = "Modern (SSR)", value = "1" }, { text = "Classic", value = "0" }, })
-- ── Only rows that work here ── -- Deviation: Turtle's rows benilla cannot honour are cut, by the name Turtle keys them -- with (Options\Options.lua). local cut = { -- What the browser page owns, not the client: the display mode and its refresh, -- the desktop's gamma ramp, multisampling, vsync and the hardware cursor. RESOLUTION = 1, WINDOWED_MODE = 1, WINDOWED_MAXIMIZED = 1, REFRESH = 1, DESKTOP_GAMMA = 1, MULTISAMPLE = 1, VERTICAL_SYNC = 1, TRIPLE_BUFFER = 1, HARDWARE_CURSOR = 1, FIX_LAG = 1, -- A CVar benilla has no reader for: `useUiScale` (the UI scale always applies), -- `lod`, `shadowLevel`, `baseMip`, the 1.12 shader switches, `movieSubtitle`. -- Spell Detail (`spellEffectLevel`) stays: it drives the particle and shard -- rates. Player Titles (`UnitNamePlayerPVPTitle`) stays: the overhead name's -- rank prefix reads it. USE_UISCALE = 1, WORLD_LOD = 1, TERRAIN_MIP = 1, TEXTURE_DETAIL = 1, ENABLE_ALL_SHADERS = 1, TERRAIN_HIGHLIGHTS = 1, FULL_SCREEN_GLOW = 1, DEATH_EFFECT = 1, VERTEX_ANIMATION_SHADERS = 1, PHONG_SHADING = 1, USE_WEATHER_SHADER = 1, CINEMATIC_SUBTITLES = 1, -- Latched at boot into every sampler (`tex_filter`), which a page reload re-reads. TRILINEAR_FILTERING = 1, ANISOTROPIC = 1, -- The engine path is missing: Simple Chat's re-layout, a zone-objective tracker, -- and the GUID `UnitExists` returns on Turtle, which its challenge lookup keys by. SIMPLE_CHAT_TEXT = 1, HIDE_OUTDOOR_WORLD_STATE_TEXT = 1, SHOW_PLAYER_CHALLENGES_TEXT = 1, } for i = getn(GameOptions), 1, -1 do local category = GameOptions[i] if ( category.options ) then for k = getn(category.options), 1, -1 do local option = category.options[k] if ( cut[option.name] ) then tremove(category.options, k) elseif ( option.name == "UI_SCALE" ) then -- Gated on a cut row (`useUiScale`): always live here. option.dependency = nil elseif ( option.name == "GAMMA" ) then -- Gated on a cut row (`desktopGamma`): always live here, and tipped -- as our window's Gamma, beside our Brightness. option.dependency = nil option.desc = BENILLA_TOOLTIP_GAMMA elseif ( option.name == "ENVIRONMENT_DETAIL" ) then -- Turtle's `smallCull` 0-2 is our `WorldDetail` 0-2, which the 1.12 -- slider of this name drives. option.cvar = "WorldDetail" elseif ( option.name == "FARCLIP" ) then -- Deviation: up to the engine's ceiling, as our window's row -- (`BENILLA_FARCLIP_MAX`). option.maxval = BENILLA_FARCLIP_MAX end end end end

"BenillaFoliageWind", cvar = "foliageWind" } }, { category = WORLD_APPEARANCE, row = { name = "BENILLA_FOLIAGE_WIND_STRENGTH", desc = BENILLA_TOOLTIP_FOLIAGE_WIND_STRENGTH, type = "slider", cvar = "foliageWindStrength", minval = 0.25, maxval = 3, step = 0.25 } }, { category = WORLD_APPEARANCE, row = { name = "BENILLA_RAIN_SURFACES", desc = BENILLA_TOOLTIP_RAIN_SURFACES, type = "checkbutton", cvar = "rainSurfaces" } }, { category = PIXEL_SHADERS, row = { name = "BENILLA_LIGHTING_MODEL", desc = BENILLA_TOOLTIP_LIGHTING_MODEL, type = "dropdown", identifier = "BenillaLightingModel", cvar =
